title: Titan UI motion study
description: A motion study of one TITAN game UI element (a HUD widget, a menu transition, a notification) from its mock and its UI tokens: the element's states and the transitions between them, timed, for review before the engine build.

body.subject: The TITAN UI element '{{element}}' from the supplied mock (input design_plate), in the states {{states}}.
body.action: Each state holds for {{state_s}} s, and each transition between states plays at its specified length {{transition_ms}} ms with its specified easing; the sequence plays once at speed, then once at quarter speed with the state names labelled.
body.camera: Fixed frame at the game's reference resolution, the element at its in-game size and position.
body.style: The element's own colours, type and sizes from {{tokens_source}}; nothing taken from the Lampway site style.
body.constraints: Write ONE scene folder: an HTML entry plus its JS, CSS, fonts and images, nothing fetched from elsewhere. Expose window.__scene = {duration_s, width, height}, an async window.__setup() that loads every font and decodes every image, then returns an object with both required arrays. Setup return example: {"fonts":[{"font":"16px Fixture Sans","ok":true}],"images":[{"src":"assets/figure.png","ok":true}]}. Each font or src identifier must be a non-empty string; ok must be a boolean, with true meaning the resource loaded. Empty-resource setup: {"fonts":[],"images":[]} is legitimate when no fonts or images are needed. window.__frame(t) sets EVERY animated property from t (seconds) alone. window.__audit() must return an object with both required arrays describing all visible text and marks at the captured time. Audit return example: {"text":[{"sel":"#title","text":"Title","box":[100,100,500,160],"font_px":28,"opacity":1}],"marks":[{"sel":"figure","box":[600,200,1000,700]}]}. Each row needs a non-empty sel and box=[x0,y0,x1,y1] in viewport pixels, with finite numeric coordinates ordered x0 <= x1 and y0 <= y1. Text rows additionally require string text, positive finite font_px and finite opacity in [0,1]; marks require sel and box. Empty audit: {"text":[],"marks":[]} is legitimate only when no text or marks are visible. No Date, performance.now, Math.random, requestAnimationFrame, CSS animations or CSS transitions: easing and any flicker are closed-form functions of t. All text inside the 5% title-safe area, at least {{min_text_px}} px tall at the output size, with contrast of at least 4.5:1 (3:1 at 24 px and up). No text over a busy image without a plate behind it. Transition lengths and easings are quoted from the tokens or the spec; where neither states one, the label on screen says 'proposed'.

min_text_px.description: the smallest text at the output size; the self-check fails under 22

transition_ms.description: transition length when the spec does not state one (labelled proposed)

tokens_source.description: project-relative path of the TITAN UI tokens or spec

negatives: no style borrowed from another product
no transition length invented without the 'proposed' label

design_plate.description: the element's mock, one per state where they exist

gates.description: requests other than file: and data: during the render (the scene must be self-contained)
sampled frame with no visible mark: share of pixels carrying a local luminance step
warning only: a nearly empty sampled frame (a weak poster frame)
visible text box outside the 5% title-safe margin
measured contrast of fully visible authored text against the pixels around it (3.0 at 24 px and up)
authored text overlapping a figure or card box
frames differing when the receipt is re-rendered by verify (same engine, sequential order)
